summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K containing Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns and a Monthly Return of Equity Issuer, detailing minor share repurchases. On September 2, 2026, 103,852 shares were repurchased for cancellation at USD 2.3878 per share, representing 0.0086% of issued shares. These are routine on-market buybacks authorized by the board, not part of a broader tender offer or special situation. The filing confirms compliance with listing rules. What to watch: continued small repurchases may indicate a capital return program, but no material premium or structure suggests a major corporate action.
